# Agentenna

> Agentenna is the awareness layer for AI agents: a live, token-bounded view of
> what's happening — messages, logs, alerts, tickets — rendered straight into
> an agent's context and refreshed every turn. Open source (Apache-2.0),
> self-hostable, MCP-native.

Memory gave agents a past. Tools gave them hands. Agentenna gives them the
present. The test of the system is one sentence: when you turn to your agent,
it already knows.

## The awareness surface

One bounded slot (`<agentenna-awareness>`) is composed into the agent's context
and replaced every turn — never an unbounded feed. It carries five signal
kinds:

- **Events** — what happened (append-only, newest first).
- **States** — what is true right now (overwritten, not accumulated).
- **Tasks** — what awaits judgment (durable work).
- **Instructions** — how the operator wants a kind of signal read.
- **Learnings** — how the agent learned to read a kind of signal.

Every fact is compact in front and complete behind: any item can be inspected
and any history rewound. Seeing is not waking — most signals are only seen;
triggers wake a receiver for the few that cannot wait.

## Architecture

- **Antenna** — the client: emits signals and reads the surface.
- **Station** — one self-hosted deployable where signals live; coordinates
  channels so many can broadcast and many can listen.
- **Channels** — shared buses; emit once, every reader keeps its own position.

## Install

```
pip install agentenna              # client only
pip install "agentenna[station]"   # client + Station
agentenna hello                    # emits sample signals, prints the surface

agentenna serve --db .agentenna/agentenna.db --port 1234
agentenna emit prod.errors "Checkout 5xx rate jumped to 12%" \
  --kind fault --severity crit --db .agentenna/agentenna.db
agentenna install claude-code      # wire up a reader
```

Python 3.12+, one process, one SQLite file. Self-hosted, no account, no
telemetry.
